note: Only 8 figures can ever be Judge and they are exactly equiprobable (8192 casts each). Under the quality table in kb/figures.yaml this makes a 'good' verdict and a 'bad' verdict unequal, so the oracle is optimistic by construction; a bare Judge cannot be read as a 50/50 coin.
judge_optimism: With the good/bad/communal labels in figures.yaml the 8 possible Judges split 2 good / 2 bad / 4 communal, i.e. exactly even odds of a good vs bad verdict and half the time the verdict is a 'communal' figure that takes its colour from the question. al-Zanātī's own counts (5 happy + 3 strong-happy vs 4 distressful, 5 mixed, of 16) are optimistic, but that optimism is a property of his classification, not of the machinery - do not quote 'geomancy is rigged favourable' without naming which quality list you used.
judge_information: the Judge carries 3 bits (8 equiprobable outcomes); a Mother carries 4. The Court is compressed by construction.

pessimism_check.claim: van Binsbergen: 'pessimistic outcomes are less frequent' because only 8 figures can be Judge
pessimism_check.conclusion: the claim reproduces: ill figures are 37.5% of the 16 but only 25% of attainable Judges (and the excluded set is 50% ill) - the compression of the mechanism, not the cosmos, flatters the answer. It is label-dependent: swap the good/bad table and the numbers move.
